about: Hand-written meta descriptions for pages whose opening text has no whole sentence short enough to be one. Shaped { lessons: {topic: text}, notes: {topic: text}, units: {chapter: text} }. Never use the mark here: no "AP" in any meta description (docs/apchem-spec.md decision 2).

notes.bond-enthalpies: Estimate a reaction's enthalpy change from average bond enthalpies: energy goes in to break bonds and comes out when bonds form, with a worked example.
notes.electron-configuration: Coulomb's law, shells, subshells and orbitals, electron configurations, valence electrons and ionization energy, explained from scratch.
notes.equilibrium-intro: Dynamic equilibrium explained: why many reactions stop short of completion and keep running both ways at equal rates.
notes.heat-transfer: Temperature, thermal energy and heat, how energy moves by collisions, and why energy lost by one object equals energy gained by another.
